Panel and header logo
Screen
Layout

Table is for the touchscreen coffee table: one player sits at each end. The board runs between them and each player has their own panel facing them. Upright is for a wall screen, laptop or phone.

White sits at the right-hand end by default. Swap ends puts White at the left-hand end.

Centre logo
Show

"!" is the Cisco Live 2026 hero graphic. It appears glowing on dark boards and on its white light-mode panel on light boards, as the brand guide shows.

Colour
Arrangement

Auto shows a mirrored pair on the table, so both players read the logo the right way up, and one logo on an upright screen.

Any angle from 0 to 359°. With one logo, 0° reads upright to someone standing at the long side of the table. With the mirrored pair, 0° has each logo facing its player.

Backing panel

A solid white or midnight panel behind the logos, as the brand guide places graphics on solid single-colour backgrounds. Auto turns it on for boards with strongly contrasting squares (Midnight, Full color).

Booth

Hides setup controls. To get back to settings: press and hold any logo for 2 seconds, or tap it three times quickly, then enter the staff PIN. Turn kiosk mode off here if you want the buttons back.

Set up this table

Staff access
